BCGK Communities -- Website Preview Build
==========================================

WHAT THIS IS
This is a UI/content preview of the BCGK Communities website: every page from
the sitemap, built with your real content, team photos, community photos, and
brand colors pulled from your logo. It's a static HTML/CSS/JS build (real
Tailwind CSS, compiled -- not a CDN mockup) so it opens directly in a browser
with no install step.

HOW TO PREVIEW
Double-click index.html and it will open in your default browser. Every page
links to every other page through the nav, footer, and buttons, so you can
click through the whole site (Home, About, Live With Us + all 5 communities,
Hire Us, Careers, Residents/Owners/Employees, Upcoming Events, legal pages).

WHAT'S REAL VS. PLACEHOLDER
- All page content, copy, property details, leadership bios, and photos: real.
- Contact form, portal login forms, careers job listings: placeholder --
  they validate and show a confirmation, but don't send real emails or check
  real credentials yet. That's intentional per your request: Postmark email
  and live portal/job-board integrations get wired up after you sign off on
  the UI.
- Upcoming Events calendar: placeholder sample events, fully interactive
  (month navigation, list/calendar toggle, community filter, click-to-open
  event details) so you can evaluate the UX before a live feed is connected.

NEXT PHASE
Once you sign off on this UI, this gets rebuilt as the production Next.js +
Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui codebase (same design, same content, componentized),
with Postmark wired up for forms and a real calendar data source.
